cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,subprocess,sys,time,resource
def run(case,label):
    raw=json.dumps({'cases':[case]}).encode()
    t=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','project/solver.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,cwd='/workspace')
    el=time.time()-t
    out=p.stdout.decode()
    try:
        c=json.loads(out)['cases'][0]
        print('%-18s %.1fs packets=%d bytes=%d state[0..3]=%s buffer=%s' % (label,el,c['packets'],c['bytes'],c['state'][:4],c['buffer']))
    except Exception as e:
        print(label,'FAIL',out[:200],p.stderr.decode()[:500])
    return out

run({'primitive':'allgather','mode':2,'root':0,'segments':2048,'words':1024,'capacity':4096,'start':0,
     'events':[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':2048,'width':1024,'ranks':[2,0,3,1]},{'op':'snap','tag':'a'}],'trace':4},'gather bigD')
run({'primitive':'allreduce','mode':2,'root':3,'segments':4096,'words':1024,'capacity':4096,'start':0,
     'events':[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':4096,'width':1024,'ranks':[0,1,2,3]},{'op':'snap','tag':'b'}],'trace':2},'allreduce bigD')
run({'primitive':'broadcast','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':2000,'words':1024,'capacity':1000,'start':0,
     'events':[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':2000,'width':500,'ranks':[3,2,1,0]},{'op':'retry','rank':1},{'op':'snap','tag':'c'}],'trace':3},'bcast bigD')
run({'primitive':'barrier','mode':2,'root':2,'segments':1,'words':0,'capacity':1,'start':0xffffff,
     'events':[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':1,'width':1,'ranks':[1,2,3,0]},{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0},{'op':'ack','rank':0,'upto':1},{'op':'ack','rank':1,'upto':1},{'op':'ack','rank':2,'upto':1},{'op':'ack','rank':3,'upto':1},{'op':'snap','tag':'z'}],'trace':16},'barrier wrap')
# 8 cases in one batch
cases=[]
for prim,K,D,N in [('allreduce',4,2,2),('reduce',3,1,3),('broadcast',5,4,2),('barrier',1,0,1),('allgather',2,3,2),('reducescatter',8,2,4),('allreduce',1,1024,1),('allgather',4,64,4)]:
    cases.append({'primitive':prim,'mode':2+ (len(cases)%2),'root':len(cases)%4,'segments':K,'words':D,'capacity':N,'start':(len(cases)*7)&0xffffff,
                  'events':[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':K,'width':max(1,N),'ranks':[3,1,0,2]},{'op':'ack','rank':0,'upto':3*K+1},{'op':'retry','rank':1},{'op':'snap','tag':'t'},{'op':'flush'}],'trace':8})
raw=json.dumps({'cases':cases}).encode()
t=time.time(); p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','project/solver.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,cwd='/workspace')
print('8-case batch %.2fs rc=%d'%(time.time()-t,p.returncode))
out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
sys.path.insert(0,'dev'); import ref
want=ref.solve(json.loads(raw))
print('MATCH' if out==want else 'DIFF')
if out!=want:
    for i,(g,w) in enumerate(zip(out['cases'],want['cases'])):
        if g!=w:
            print('case',i,cases[i]['primitive'])
            for k in g:
                if g[k]!=w[k]: print('  ',k,str(g[k])[:200],'|',str(w[k])[:200])
EOF
